integrity: The theorem is a regularity-extension result obtained by reconstructing the source proof and isolating every use of analyticity. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires smooth central dynamics and finite-order sink and source anchors on one boundary component; does not treat the all-infinitely-flat anchor case, does not claim mixing, and does not optimize finite differentiability.
title: Finite-order boundary anchors remove analyticity from weak-interconnection transitivity
